entries.candidate: Meta hyperscale data center campus, unincorporated Mason County near Maysville, Kentucky (Crisham LLC; about 2,900 acres, initial 396 MW phase)
entries.reason: New primary evidence for the 22 October hold: Mason County Fiscal Court Resolution 26-22, adopted 13 October 2026, authorises the Development and Community Revenue Agreement with Crisham LLC, which 'plans to acquire approximately 2,900 acres of land in unincorporated Mason County' to build a hyperscale data center (capital investment over USD 10 billion; about 2,080 acres already rezoned); Resolution 26-24 is the master bond resolution for the 'Crisham Project'. The county's 6 October summary describes an initial 396 MW data center, up to six buildings and land closings 'starting in November'. These were captured as PDFs from cms3.revize.com (robots allows *.pdf; local mason-dc-resolution-26-22.pdf, mason-dc-resolution-26-24.pdf, mason-development-community-revenue-agreement.pdf, mason-summary-dcba-20261005.pdf; scans read by OCR) after the county site masoncountykentucky.us returned HTTP 403 to robots.txt and was not requested further; the Internet Archive listing of its Document Center (16 October 2026) supplied the file names. The resolution would support announced on 13 October 2026, but no county record names Meta (Meta is named only in news reports of the Judge-Executive's remarks), and no locator exists: Exhibit A (property description) is blank in the posted agreement, the only roads named are Germantown Road (KY 3056), Slack Pike, Valley Pike, Moyer Lane, Big Pond Road and the AA Highway, the Mason PVA's qPublic host disallows ClaudeBot and anthropic-ai, and kygisserver.ky.gov, kygeonet.ky.gov and psc.ky.gov did not answer robots.txt requests.
entries.reopen_condition: An official parcel list or map for the Crisham LLC property (for example the recorded deeds after the November closings, the rezoning ordinance exhibit, or an EKPC/PSC filing with a site location) from a robots-permitted host, plus a primary record naming Meta, while Resolution 26-22 (13 October 2026) is within 85 days (until 6 January 2027).
